items.title: Joanne Brackeen interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 10, 2001
items.q: that’s like featuring Paquito as one of the guests on there

ctx.x: And I hope you keep writing, you have a very distinctive sound to your work.

Oh thank you, thanks. Well I have two new CDs, they’re not out yet, and they both have new compositions on them. One I recorded live at the Jazz Standard that was with Negro, my regular drummer and Ira Coleman and Ravi Coltrane. And then I did a CD that was very interesting, Latin American music but world Latin American. Like some from Spain, some from Cuba, from Chile, from Brazil, from all over, and that’s like featuring Paquito as one of the guests on there and Farid Haque is playing guitar, with Negro once…
Is the Latin music of so many different places rhythmically, it’s all a little different, isn’t it?
